description: Transform ConceptsScreen from passive display into interactive workspace with detail panel, smart sidebar navigation, and pipeline status display.

userStories.title: Create ConceptDetailPanel Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click on a concept card and see a detailed side drawer panel so that I can inspect all concept metadata without leaving the concepts page.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel appears on right side with overlay backdrop (z-50/z-51)
Panel slides in from right (~300ms animation)
All concept fields displayed (name, level, domain, themes, description)

userStories.title: Create ConceptsSidebar Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want an enhanced sidebar with navigation, pipeline status, and filters so that I can navigate contextually and monitor extraction progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Three collapsible sections using Accordion component
Navigation section: Upload, Concepts, Results always visible
Navigation section: Analyze/Explore/Provenance only when concept selected
Pipeline Status section shows state badge (idle/running/done/error)
Pipeline Status section shows concept count, domain count, extraction time
Filters section contains all existing FilterPanel functionality

userStories.title: Wire Up ConceptsScreen Integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want clicking concept cards to open the detail panel and the sidebar to reflect my selection so that the UI feels cohesive and responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking ConceptCard opens ConceptDetailPanel with correct data
